verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows Mastra itself (its CLI, Studio, or server) being operated through natural-language commands. Docs describe creating agents with a single CLI command and building or testing agents in Studio. A user chatting with an agent they built (comm-13) is a capability of the user's own agent, a developer building block, not natural-language operation of the product. llms.txt and docs.md are AI-readable documentation, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
